subject: Pricing bands & starter discount — follow-up
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@picket.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing bands & starter discount — follow-up

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned: 

- What we heard: Picket.ai expects 50–200M tokens/month in Q3 with a pilot at ~10M tokens/month starting next month. Long term you may ramp to ~800M/month by Q4 next year if the new real-time summarization feature hits adoption targets.
- Main constraints: engineering budget for H2 is limited (~$250k–$400k annual for inference), procurement needs clear unit pricing and committed-use options, and security questionnaire (SOC2 + audit logs) must be complete before PROD.

I pulled the closest pricing bands and a starter discount option — see the attached redwood_pricing_grid_v2.pdf. High level options: 

A) Pay-as-you-go (no commit): $X / 1M tokens (baseline), good if volume is variable;
B) 12-month committed use (1-way): tiered unit price, target $/1M improves at 100M+ tokens/mo;
C) Startup program + 12-mo commit: one-time upfront credit + 15% credit on committed spend for first 6 months.

Two asks from you so we can finalize a tailored proposal: 
1) Confirm expected average and peak tokens/month during the next 12 months (if you can provide month-by-month that’s ideal).
2) What target $/1M tokens would make a 12-month committed contract compelling for Picket? For readability, give a single benchmark number (e.g., $500 / 1M tokens).

If you prefer, we can propose two committed-tier options (conservative ramp and aggressive ramp) and include a multi-year incentive for 2-year commitment. I’ve cc’d Grace from our pricing team to help with unit economics.

Next step: if you can reply with the two items above, I’ll send a formal MUP quote and the procurement checklist. If procurement is ready to engage directly, loop them in and we’ll coordinate a short SOW + contract template.

Thanks —
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood_pricing_grid_v2.pdf (2 pages, table of bands), proposed-mup-terms-1yr.docx (term stub)

From: Sarah Kim <sarah@picket.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Picket.ai Procurement <procurement@picket.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing bands & starter discount — follow-up

Thanks Ben — good summary and useful call. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot plan: start with 10M tokens/mo (June), then 30M/mo (July), 70M/mo (Aug–Sep), and we expect to hit ~150M/mo by Nov if initial metrics hold. Those are our best estimates for now.
- Budget: as a company we’re targeting inference spend under $350k ARR for the first year of the feature. That’s a hard constraint unless we can justify upside.
- Target unit economics: to consider a 12-month committed contract, we’re looking for effective rates around $300–$400 per 1M tokens (net of any credits). At $300 / 1M we can justify a heavier commit.
- Program ask: Do you have a startup program discount (we’re YC '24, pre-revenue on this product) and any multi-year incentives? Procurement wants to see concrete % off and commitment thresholds.

Looping in procurement for contractual language — procurement, does the $350k ARR constraint make sense for negotiating a 12-mo MUP?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Sarah
Head of Product, Picket.ai
[sarah@picket.ai]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah@picket.ai>, Picket.ai Procurement <procurement@picket.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing bands & starter discount — follow-up

Sarah — thanks for the details, that’s very helpful. Two quick notes and a proposed starter structure: 

1) Budget alignment: with $350k ARR target and the ramp you shared, a fully net effective $/1M in the $300–$400 range could work if we layer credits and a modest commit. I ran a back-of-envelope for the 12-month path you described and included a sample calculation in the attached pricing_grid. It assumes a 12-mo MUP with a 30% upfront commit of expected first-year consumption to get the lower unit price bands.

2) Starter proposal (what I can offer without exec approval):
- Startup program: 20% off list unit price for the first 6 months (requires YC proof + startup form).
- 12-month MUP (net of starter): tiered pricing where effective unit price reaches ~$340 / 1M at ~100–150M average monthly consumption; at 300M+ we get to ~$260 / 1M.
- Multi-year incentive (prelim): an additional 8% discount on committed spend if you sign a 24-month MUP; this needs approval from finance but we can include in the term sheet as contingent.

Action items: 
- Sarah / procurement: can you confirm whether YC verification is available (standard) and whether procurement is comfortable sharing a month-level forecast for 12 months? That forecast lets us produce a binding quote with exact unit prices.
- Grace / Lauren (internal): if procurement confirms the $350k ARR upper bound, can we model the 12-mo MUP that yields effective ~$330–$360 / 1M for Picket, and then a version that hits $300 / 1M with a 24-mo commit + multi-year incentive? I’ve attached the proposed-mup-terms-1yr.docx for procurement to review.

If procurement wants to move straight to contract redlines, I can route to legal and supply a DocuSign link.

Thanks —
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Picket.ai Procurement <procurement@picket.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sarah Kim <sarah@picket.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing bands & starter discount — follow-up

Hi Ben / Sarah — procurement here. Confirming the $350k ARR constraint is real for the first-year budget line. A couple of asks to move forward quickly: 

1) Can Redwood provide a clean quote showing: list unit $/1M, startup credit applied, and final effective $/1M for the 12-mo MUP at the forecasted ramp (please show month-by-month and blended effective rate)?
2) We need a one-page addendum that shows the cancellation terms and risk protections (data retention, termination charges, SLA).
3) If Redwood can show a pathway to ~$300 / 1M net with a 24-month MUP and a defined multi-year rebate, we can present that to Finance next week.

If you can push the quote + one-pager by EOD Wednesday PST we’ll schedule a short review with Finance on Thursday.

Thanks —
Procurement Team
Picket.ai
procurement@picket.ai
